title: acmella papposa var. macrophylla
intro: Acmella papposa var. macrophylla, commonly known as the 'Paraguay tea', is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acmella papposa var. macrophylla include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as parthenolide, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
